text: Port agent-intercom (Rust) to a feature-complete, CGO-free Go implementation. Authoritative spec: docs/decisions/2026-07-06-go-port-reference-brief.md. Deliberation: docs/decisions/2026-09-03-intercom-go-architecture-reconciliation-deliberation.md (Group A). PARTIALLY HARVESTED 2026-09-03: the foundation slice (module skeleton + hardened CI gates) became feature 001-F / shipment 001-S. Config schema, credential resolution, and the AppError taxonomy were split out to stash 037B1552 by plan review. REMAINING SCOPE (not yet planned), per brief section 12 phases 1-8: the three front-loaded risk slices (Slack Socket Mode via slack-go, ACP subprocess spawn/handshake/reader/writer, SQLite via modernc.org/sqlite); SQLite schema (7 tables) + 8 repos + retention; AgentDriver interface and ACP driver + event consumer; Slack surface (block kit, slash commands, modals, all interaction handlers, US17 thread @-mention replies); approval workflow + terminal-command gate + auto-approve policy + atomic in-root diff apply + audit; resilience (stall detect/nudge/escalate, steering queue at-least-once, reconnect/repost, crash respawn+resume); IPC + intercom-ctl companion CLI; and the parity sweep against the Rust test corpus (56 unit / 22 contract / 46 integration / 6 live / 13 Playwright). It is intentionally NOT a submodule or gitlink of this repository - there is no .gitmodules file and no references entry in the parent index. The oracle-mount blocker is RESOLVED; no blockers remain on this entry.

Copilot Remote Multiplexer backend: per-workspace Go process with Bubble Tea TUI, gorilla/websocket server, Microsoft Dev Tunnels transport, coder/acp-go-sdk, in-memory State Hydrator for late-joiner iOS clients, and autoharness process/port orchestration. Source: docs/design-docs/intercom-go-backend-architecture.md. BLOCKED - requires architecture reconciliation before planning. Deliberation: docs/decisions/2026-09-03-intercom-go-architecture-reconciliation-deliberation.md (Group B). Three load-bearing conflicts with the agent-intercom Go port brief: (1) durability model - the brief's recover_state/ADR-0011, crash respawn+resume, at-least-once steering with origin_session_id rebind, and retention pruning are semantics unimplementable on an in-memory SessionState, while late-joiner hydration is definitionally in-memory; (2) operator surface is embedded in the persistence schema - slack_ts appears in 5 of 7 tables and thread_ts/channel_id are session columns, so Slack is not a pluggable presentation layer; (3) lifecycle ownership - one server routing many [[workspace]] channels under max_concurrent_sessions with intercom-ctl over IPC, versus one process per workspace with ports allocated by a Python parent. ARCHITECTURE REVIEW CORRECTION: the deliberation's unresolved option (c) mischaracterized AgentDriver as a seam for an additional operator surface. AgentDriver is AGENT-facing (SendPrompt/Interrupt/ResolveClearance). The multiplexer's TUI/WebSocket/iOS adapters are OPERATOR-facing. Composition would need a separate OperatorGateway interface over shared session events, with the SDK-backed ACP broker implementing AgentDriver. Reconciliation must still independently decide persistence model and deployment topology - AgentDriver does not resolve those.

intercom-go config package and error taxonomy (deferred from foundation slice by plan review). Scope: config.toml schema per port brief section 9, config load+validation, credential resolution (env with *_ACP precedence + OS keychain fallback), and the AppError 14-variant taxonomy per section 10. DEFERRED because these are Group-A-specific (not fork-independent) and should be validated against the Rust behavioral oracle before being frozen as operator-facing contracts. Source: docs/decisions/2026-07-06-go-port-reference-brief.md. Plan review findings to apply: (P1-e) canonicalize+EvalSymlinks workspace roots and emit PathViolation, add absolute-path invariant; (P1-g) 'ACP mode' predicate is undefined - make host_cli unconditionally required per ACP-only direction; (P1-h) decode into a pre-populated Default() struct so explicit false/0 is not overwritten by post-decode defaults; (P1-i) add SlackConfig for the [slack] section or strict unknown-key rejection will reject the first real config.toml; (P1-j) implement Is() for the error kind and reserve Unwrap() for the wrapped cause - a single Unwrap cannot serve both; (P1-l) introduce 'type Secret string' with redacting String/GoString/MarshalJSON/LogValue so no-secret-in-logs holds by type not convention. Also: move credential lookup out of internal/config behind a provider interface; consider package-local errors translated at boundaries instead of one central taxonomy; fixtures MUST be synthetic (never copied from an operator config.toml); adopt testify and add tests/contract + tests/integration when first needed.
